we propose a model-based approach for recovering motion parameters of a walking person from monocular video sequences in a CON-DENSATION framework.
we have proposed a new model for human motion analysis that is able to recover motion parameters from monocular image sequence with high accuracy and robustness.

(1) a model-based approach can recover motion parameters of walking human in a CONDENSE framework; (2) a pose evaluation function is modeled with the radial term to improve both accuracy and robustness of the factored sample; (3) a motion constraints is explored by considering the dependency between motion parameters and represented as a conditional distribution; (4) a semi-automatically acquisition of training data is proposed to reduce the labor cost
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following three problems: (1) How to learn motion parameters and motion constraints from a small amount of training data; (2) How to integrate motion parameters and motion constrains to form an efficient dynamic model; (3) How to automatically recover from severe failures.
